name: com.leochaumartin.quill
description: A declarative, reactive UI framework for Unity. Author interfaces in .ui documents with reactive bindings, anchors, positioners, reusable components, signals, animations, custom shaders, and a clean C# interop layer. Rendered at a low level (single SDF pass for rectangles, lightweight textured layers for text/images/effects), independent of uGUI and UI Toolkit. URP and Built-in render pipelines supported.

samples.description: A widget gallery and a full game-menu hierarchy, with a bootstrap component.
